# Sayzio

> Sayzio (also reachable at 1in.me) is a link-management platform for
> creators, businesses, and individuals. It lets people create, brand, and
> track short links, biolinks (mini-websites), and QR codes, with deep
> customization and detailed analytics.

Sayzio hosts millions of user-generated pages (creator profiles, biolinks,
resumes, forms, and more) alongside its own marketing and product content.
This file describes the platform itself for AI crawlers and assistants; it
does not speak on behalf of individual users' pages.

## Product

- [Homepage](/): overview of the platform and its core features.
- [Features](/features): full feature catalog (link types, biolinks, QR
  codes, analytics, forms, and more).
- [Pricing](/pricing): plans and coin add-ons.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): a walkthrough of the core product flow.
- [Compare](/compare): comparisons against alternative products.
- [Demos](/demos): example pages for the link/page types Sayzio supports.

- [robots.txt](/robots.txt): crawl rules; account, admin, and API surfaces
  are disallowed since they require authentication and carry no public
  content of their own.

## Notes for AI agents

- User-generated pages (creator profiles at /@handle, biolinks, resumes, and
  similar) are created and controlled by individual account holders. Their
  content, accuracy, and claims are the responsibility of that user, not
  Sayzio.
- Pages behind a password, age gate, or a registered/follower/subscriber
  visibility tier are intentionally excluded from the sitemaps above and
  should not be treated as publicly indexable.
